commits.content: --- Title: Lanie (RareBird15) Date: 2026-03-31 Category: Home Slug: index Summary: Home page for Lanie Carmelo, focusing on accessibility, faith, technology, and disability advocacy. --- Working at the intersection of faith, technology, and disability advocacy. My work focuses on **accessibility** as both a technical responsibility and a reflection of God’s love for His children, grounded in **faith**, **technology**, and **disability advocacy**. ## What I Focus On - **Accessibility & usability testing**: Evaluating software and digital tools with a focus on real-world accessibility for disabled users. - **Programming & learning**: Developing skills and projects with accessibility in mind from the start. - **Disability advocacy**: Sharing lived experience to help make technology more inclusive for people with multiple disabilities. - **Faith-informed perspective**: Approaching life, work, and advocacy through a Christ-centered lens. - **Documenting accessibility barriers**: Writing about recurring accessibility challenges I encounter in games and interactive media, grounded in lived experience as a blind, autistic, chronically ill user. --- ## Learn More - [About Me](/about/) - [Work and Learning](/work-and-learning/) - [Selected Writing](/writing/) - [Accessibility Notes](/accessibility-notes/) --- ## Connect You can find my current updates and reflections on Mastodon: - Mastodon - GitHub - LinkedIn - [Email](mailto:lanie.rarebird15@gmail.com) --- _Faith, technology, and disability advocacy — working toward a more accessible world._ This site is intentionally small and updated selectively.
